Every page shows a published model, the experimental data it was validated
against, and a `pymrm` reproduction with a quantitative agreement metric.

**Filtering.** Every page carries tags on five axes at once. The **Categories**
panel groups them by axis — click a tag to filter, click *Categories* to clear.

| Axis | Meaning | Example |
|---|---|---|
| **Section** | Catalog section — the physical domain, listed below | `A` transport closures, `D` fixed bed |
| **Structure** | Mathematical structure — *the axis to filter on if you want to reuse code* | `S8` nested reactor–particle coupling |
| **Tier** | Standing in the literature | `T0` canonical |
| **Data** | Provenance tier of the dataset | `tier1` open repository, `tier6` reference solution |
| **Phase** | Phase system | `gas`, `gas-solid` |

### The section letters

The catalog is divided into ten sections by physical domain. Only the sections
that already have a page appear in the filter panel.

| | | | |
|---|---|---|---|
| **A** Transport & closure relations | **B** Catalyst particle & intraparticle transport | **C** Reaction kinetics | **D** Fixed / packed bed reactors |
| **E** Fluidised beds | **F** Gas–liquid & slurry reactors | **G** Three-phase packed beds | **H** Membrane reactors & separations |
| **I** Structured & intensified reactors | **J** Adjacent unit operations | | |

Section and structure codes are both defined in full in
[`docs/taxonomy.md`](https://github.com/computational-chemical-engineering/pymrm-gallery/blob/main/docs/taxonomy.md);
hovering a tag in the panel shows what it means. Two pages sharing a structure
code are solved by nearly the same pymrm code even when their physics is
unrelated — that is the intended route to reuse.

::: {#model-listing}
:::

```{=html}
<script>
// Regroup Quarto's category cloud into one block per classification axis.
//
// The tags are prefixed (sec:, struct:, tier:, data:, phase:) so that a single
// flat list can carry five axes. Left alone, Quarto sorts them alphabetically
// and scales each one's font size by how many pages use it -- which interleaves
// the axes, repeats the prefix on every chip, puts struct:S10 before struct:S2,
// and makes a rare tag look less important than a common one when the tags are
// a filter, not a measure of popularity.
//
// The existing elements are MOVED, never cloned or rebuilt, so the click
// handlers Quarto attached to them keep working, and
// `.quarto-listing-category .category[data-category=...]` still matches for
// activation from the URL hash.
(function () {
  var AXES = [
    { prefix: "sec", label: "Section" },
    { prefix: "struct", label: "Structure" },
    { prefix: "tier", label: "Tier" },
    { prefix: "data", label: "Data" },
    { prefix: "phase", label: "Phase" },
  ];

  // A bare "A" or "S8" on a chip says nothing on its own, so the meaning goes
  // in the tooltip. Kept in step with docs/taxonomy.md, Axes 1 and 2.
  var MEANING = {
    "sec:A": "Transport & closure relations",
    "sec:B": "Catalyst particle & intraparticle transport",
    "sec:C": "Reaction kinetics",
    "sec:D": "Fixed / packed bed reactors",
    "sec:E": "Fluidised beds",
    "sec:F": "Gas–liquid & slurry reactors",
    "sec:G": "Three-phase packed beds",
    "sec:H": "Membrane reactors & separations",
    "sec:I": "Structured & intensified reactors",
    "sec:J": "Adjacent unit operations",
    "struct:S1": "ODE-IVP in time (batch, CSTR dynamics)",
    "struct:S2": "ODE-IVP in space (ideal PFR marching)",
    "struct:S3": "1D steady BVP (particle, film)",
    "struct:S4": "1D transient PDE (axial dispersion, breakthrough)",
    "struct:S5": "1D convection-dominated (sharp fronts)",
    "struct:S6": "2D PDE (radial dispersion, Graetz, monolith)",
    "struct:S7": "Multi-domain / multi-phase coupling",
    "struct:S8": "Nested-scale coupling (reactor ↔ particle)",
    "struct:S9": "Implicit multicomponent flux (Maxwell–Stefan, dusty gas)",
    "struct:S10": "DAE / constrained (pressure–velocity, electroneutrality)",
    "struct:S11": "Population balance (internal coordinate)",
    "struct:S12": "Moving boundary / shrinking core",
    "struct:S13": "Non-standard geometry",
    "tier:T0": "Canonical — taught everywhere, still the reference formulation",
    "tier:T1": "Field standard — the default model in its subfield",
    "tier:T2": "Established alternative — competes with the field standard",
    "tier:T3": "Specialised or emerging",
    "data:tier1": "Open repository",
    "data:tier2": "Table printed in the paper",
    "data:tier3": "Supplementary material",
    "data:tier4": "Digitised from a figure",
    "data:tier5": "Obtained from the authors",
    "data:tier6": "Reference or exact solution, not experiment",
  };

  // "S10" must sort after "S2", so compare any trailing digits numerically.
  function naturalKey(s) {
    var m = /^(\D*)(\d*)(.*)$/.exec(s);
    return [m[1], m[2] === "" ? -1 : parseInt(m[2], 10), m[3]];
  }
  function naturalCmp(a, b) {
    var ka = naturalKey(a), kb = naturalKey(b);
    return (
      ka[0].localeCompare(kb[0]) || ka[1] - kb[1] || ka[2].localeCompare(kb[2])
    );
  }

  function group() {
    var cloud = document.querySelector(
      ".quarto-listing-category.category-cloud"
    );
    if (!cloud || cloud.dataset.grouped === "1") return;

    var items = Array.prototype.slice
      .call(cloud.querySelectorAll(":scope > .category"))
      .map(function (el) {
        var full = (el.textContent || "").trim();
        var i = full.indexOf(":");
        return {
          el: el,
          full: full,
          prefix: i > 0 ? full.slice(0, i) : "",
          rest: i > 0 ? full.slice(i + 1) : full,
        };
      });
    if (!items.length) return;

    var buckets = {}, order = [];
    items.forEach(function (it) {
      var key = it.prefix || "_other";
      if (!buckets[key]) {
        buckets[key] = [];
        order.push(key);
      }
      buckets[key].push(it);
    });

    var known = AXES.map(function (a) { return a.prefix; });
    var sequence = AXES.filter(function (a) { return buckets[a.prefix]; }).concat(
      order
        .filter(function (k) { return known.indexOf(k) === -1; })
        .map(function (k) {
          return { prefix: k, label: k === "_other" ? "Other" : k };
        })
    );

    var frag = document.createDocumentFragment();
    sequence.forEach(function (axis) {
      var bucket = buckets[axis.prefix];
      bucket.sort(function (a, b) { return naturalCmp(a.rest, b.rest); });

      var group = document.createElement("div");
      group.className = "gallery-cat-group";
      var label = document.createElement("span");
      label.className = "gallery-cat-group-label";
      label.textContent = axis.label;
      group.appendChild(label);

      var chips = document.createElement("div");
      chips.className = "gallery-cat-chips";
      bucket.forEach(function (it) {
        // the full prefixed tag stays reachable, and where the short label is
        // not self-explanatory the tooltip says what it means
        var meaning = MEANING[it.full];
        it.el.setAttribute("title", meaning ? it.full + " — " + meaning : it.full);
        var span = it.el.querySelector(".quarto-category-count") || it.el;
        if (it.prefix) span.textContent = it.rest;
        chips.appendChild(it.el); // move, preserving Quarto's onclick
      });
      group.appendChild(chips);
      frag.appendChild(group);
    });

    cloud.appendChild(frag);
    cloud.dataset.grouped = "1";

    var title = document.querySelector(".quarto-listing-category-title");
    if (title && !document.querySelector(".gallery-category-hint")) {
      var hint = document.createElement("span");
      hint.className = "gallery-category-hint";
      hint.textContent = "Click a tag to filter; click Categories to clear.";
      title.parentNode.insertBefore(hint, title.nextSibling);
    }
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", group);
  } else {
    group();
  }
  window.addEventListener("load", group); // in case the listing renders late
})();
</script>
```
